label: Postmark
terms_note: Automation allowed: base https://api.postmarkapp.com, X-Postmark-Server-Token for server-level calls (send, templates, bounces, messages, stats), X-Postmark-Account-Token for account-level (servers, sender signatures, domains); 401 on a missing header; 429 when rate-limited (no published number). Email API: POST /email — From must be a confirmed Sender Signature / verified domain, max 50 recipients To + Cc + Bcc combined, 10 MB per message; Batch API 500 messages / 50 MB per call; Bulk API for broadcast streams (newsletters, announcements) bounded by the 50 MB payload; MessageStream selects transactional ('outbound' default) vs broadcast streams. Inbound: a per-server inbound address or an inbound forwarding domain → JSON webhook (From/To/Cc/Bcc + Full variants, Subject, TextBody, HtmlBody, StrippedTextReply, Headers incl. X-Spam-*, Attachments base64, MessageID, MailboxHash for plus-addressing); retries up to 10 times over 1 min → 6 h, a 403 stops retries.

sdks: Official libraries: TypeScript / Node.js, Python, Ruby gem + Rails, .NET, Java, PHP, CLI, WordPress (postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview)

endpoints.call: POST /email` `{From, To, Cc, Bcc, Subject, HtmlBody
endpoints.purpose: TextBody, ReplyTo, Headers[{Name,Value}], Tag, Metadata, TrackOpens, TrackLinks, Attachments, MessageStream}` → `{MessageID, ErrorCode 0, SubmittedAt}`

endpoints.call: Inbound webhook (per-server inbound address or inbound forwarding domain → JSON POST)
endpoints.notes: fields From/To/Cc/Bcc (+Full), Subject, TextBody, HtmlBody, StrippedTextReply, Headers (X-Spam-*), Attachments (base64), MessageID, MailboxHash; retries 10× over 1 min → 6 h, 403 stops retries

endpoints.call: Webhooks API (delivery, bounce, open, click, spam complaint, subscription change)

reference.limits: - Rate limiting exists (429) — no published request-per-second number. - Transactional vs Broadcast **message streams** are separate; broadcast sends must go to a broadcast stream (the unsubscribe requirement for broadcasts was not re-read today because the page 404'd — keep RFC 8058 headers on every follow-up / broadcast regardless, per messaging.md). - Automation is the intended use; Postmark's content policy applies (no purchased lists).

sandbox.notes: Postmark test mode is a token, not a host: 'passing the POSTMARK_API_TEST value in the X-Postmark-Server-Token header field' validates a send without delivering it. Set PLATFORM_MCP_POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN=POSTMARK_API_TEST; reads (message streams, stats) need a real server token.

fields.name: server_token
fields.help: Postmark server API token, sent as the X-Postmark-Server-Token header ('requests that require server level privileges'; 401 'Missing or incorrect API token in header', https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview).

config_fields.name: sender
config_fields.help: Sender address used as `From` on every send: 'Sender email address. Registered and confirmed Sender Signature is required' (https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/email-api). Env: PLATFORM_MCP_POSTMARK_SENDER.

adapter.rate_note: No request-per-second number is published; 429 'We have detected that you are making requests at a rate that exceeds acceptable use of the API' (https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview). Client-side bucket kept at the runtime default of 2/s.

me.note: GET /server ('requires server level privileges') describes the server the token belongs to (ID, Name, DeliveryType, InboundAddress, ...).

send.note: `From` comes from the per-install `sender` config field; `to` may be a comma-separated list (max 50 recipients); `text` is sent as TextBody; `channel`, when given, is the MessageStream id. status is Postmark's `Message` ('OK'); 422 on invalid fields → isError.

list_inbound.note: Inbound message search (`count` 'Number of messages to return per request. Max 500', `offset` 'Number of messages to skip'; status defaults to processed). The search list carries no body: `text` is unset (subject under raw.Subject; TextBody on GET /messages/inbound/{messageid}/details). `since` and `channel` are not sent.

not_offered.reply: Threading on POST /email needs Headers[{Name, Value}] (In-Reply-To / References), an array the adapter's flat body map cannot express (https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/email-api).
not_offered.get_thread: GET /messages/inbound/{messageid}/details returns one message, not a conversation; no thread listing is documented (https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/messages-api).
not_offered.mark_read: No read-state endpoint exists in the Postmark API (https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/overview).

evidence: probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 3/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
auth_audit.notes: Postmark's published test token POSTMARK_API_TEST is accepted only on /email ('The Postmark Test API Token may only be used on the /email endpoint'), so no read could be verified with it; send was not called (write).
